en: Black‑and‑white image of a street or promenade with wet pavement, showing people walking in front of low, pavilion‑like buildings with tiled roofs. The right building has striped awnings and several large wall signs, one reading "RÖMELINGS WURST‑BUDEN" and mentioning "Pumuckl." Another building on the left has a sign over the entrance reading "DOLLS THEATER." Trees without leaves and lampposts suggest a cool season. The overall look is that of an early 20th‑century fairground or amusement area.
